answer: A chained-task bond ties one identity to one sequence of work. A newcomer locks 60 credits and joins the dune registry, which records each link. An ember beacon picks the next task type, so no clone can prepare the chain in advance. Each link must return an echo signed to one identity key; a copied link repeats an echo and is rejected, burning the bond. The kth fake identity needs its own bond and five-link chain, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits and do 5,000 tasks. Chain rental fails because an echo replayed under another key is refused. An honest agent locks 60 credits.
